company.name: Waabi
company.shortDescription: Waabi develops autonomous driving technology and physical artificial intelligence systems for the transportation sector.
company.description: Waabi develops autonomous driving technology and physical artificial intelligence systems for the transportation sector. The company designs and applies end-to-end AI models and simulation tools to enable self-driving capabilities for trucks and extend these technologies to robotaxis and other automated vehicle platforms. Its offerings include AI-based software for vehicle perception, planning, and control that integrate with partners’ hardware and fleet operations. Waabi collaborates with manufacturers and mobility platforms to integrate its autonomous systems into commercial transport and ride-hailing services. The company also builds large-scale simulation environments to train and validate its vehicle automation technologies.

productsAndServices.description: A neural simulator for developing and validating autonomous-driving systems by reproducing routine conditions, rare edge cases, sensor data, and vehicle interactions in virtual environments.

aiResearchSummary.text: Waabi is researching and developing autonomous driving technology through areas such as learning unsupervised world models for autonomous driving, latent representation based appearance modification for adversarial testing and training, automatic labeling of objects from LiDAR point clouds via trajectory-level refinement, multimodal four-dimensional panoptic segmentation, and validation for autonomous systems. Their work also includes mixed reality simulation, motion forecasting, and trajectory value learning for autonomous systems.
